subject: Short standby & CTO docking plan for Thursday demo
messages:
From: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kayla Rivera <kayla.rivera@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T08:15:00-05:00
Subject: Quick ask — possible CTO drop-in for Thursday?

Hi Vanessa,

Quick heads-up from our side. Larry Kim (our CTO) is taking an overnight redeye and is trying to land in time to hop on the demo on Thursday morning. His window is tight — looks like he may only be able to join between 10:20–10:40 ET before heading to HQ.

Would you be able to hold a 20-minute standby slot for him (short technical check + a quick executive Q&A)? If that’s not feasible, can we do a brief 15-minute follow-up immediately after for Larry only?

I attached his arrival ETA (cto-itinerary.pdf) so you can see the buffer. Kayla and I are flexible — we just don’t want to surprise him with a full 45–60 minute session.

Appreciate any contingency plan you can propose.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive, Acme Corp

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@acme.com>
Cc: Kayla Rivera <kayla.rivera@acme.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — possible CTO drop-in for Thursday?

On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 08:15 AM Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@acme.com> wrote:
> Hi Vanessa,
>
> Quick heads-up from our side. Larry Kim (our CTO) is taking an overnight redeye and is trying to land in time to hop on the demo on Thursday morning....

Jordan — thanks for the heads-up. We can absolutely accommodate a CTO "dock-and-brief" if we plan for a short, focused window and a fallback. Proposed approach: 

- Hold 10:15–10:40 ET as a standby buffer on the calendar. We’ll run the scheduled demo at 10:00 and keep 10:15–10:40 reserved in case Larry can join for a 15–20 minute executive touchpoint.
- If Larry can only make 10:20–10:35, we’ll compress the executive Q&A and prioritize technical highlights (KV cache behavior, latency at 4k context, and the dedicated deployment SLA).
- Marcus will be the primary for the 10:15–10:40 technical deep-dive if the CTO wants specifics; Irene will handle the contract/ops questions if they come up.
- If Larry cannot join, we’ll offer a 15-minute post-demo follow-up slot (same day) for exec questions.

I attached a slimmed agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf). Action items: can Kayla or Jordan confirm Larry’s likely ETA by EOD so we can update the invite and pre-brief Marcus? Also tagging Marcus and Irene to confirm coverage.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: demo-agenda-v2.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@acme.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:25:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — possible CTO drop-in for Thursday?

Vanessa / Jordan — I can cover the compressed technical window. Proposed changes to the flow if CTO joins: 

- 10:00–10:15: Core product demo (trimmed to key customer outcomes).
- 10:15–10:35: Tech deep-dive for CTO (I’ll focus on latency SLOs, routing/fallback behavior, and quantization trade-offs).
- If Larry can only do 10:20–10:30, I’ll skip the deployment examples and go straight to latency/cost slides.

I’ll be on the 10:00 invite and will have a 2-slide backup specifically tailored for CTO-level questions. Vanessa — if you want, I’ll drop those slides in the Drive link under the demo folder by EOD.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kayla Rivera <kayla.rivera@acme.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:30:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — possible CTO drop-in for Thursday?

Vanessa / team — quick update: Larry’s flight landed slightly early and he confirmed he can dial in at ~10:20 ET for about 18–22 minutes. He asked only for the short exec touchpoint (no deep follow-up needed right away).

We’ve updated the calendar invite to show a 10:15–10:40 standby window and added Larry (larry.kim@acme.com). I attached his itinerary again for your reference (cto-itinerary.pdf).

Thanks for the quick pivot — Marcus, please use the two CTO slides you mentioned and we’ll keep questions to the high-impact bullets.

Jordan
Account Executive, Acme Corp
(Attachment: cto-itinerary.pdf)
